source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-hcb3-uniform-square-lower — Uniform square lower estimate: there are universal K_sq < infinity and e_sq > 0 such that every H-CB datum with e <= e_sq, every n >= 1, and every Z in M_n tensor S_P satisfy ||Z^dagger dot Z|| >= (1-K_sq*e)||Z||^2.
